g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Coincident crown/brim and upper/sole boundaries are sampled once. The boot top hidden inside the shaft-opening oval is omitted; shared junctions reuse dots. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Hat crown/brim and footwear upper/sole receive lower grey surfaces bounded by higher black lines. Boot shaft opening stays white unraised. Original painter order retains single visible contact boundaries. No measured heights or realistic shading.
